spec.credit: UPSC CSE (Main) 2021 · General Studies Paper I · Q7
spec.text: Mention the global occurrence of volcanic eruptions in 2021 and their impact on regional environment.

scenes.vo: UPSC, twenty twenty-one. General Studies Paper One, ten marks, one hundred and fifty words. Mention the global occurrence of volcanic eruptions in twenty twenty-one. Then give their impact on regional environment. Here's a trap. One famous eruption feels like it belongs in this answer, and it doesn't.

spec.text: Mention the global occurrence of volcanic eruptions in 2021 and their impact on regional environment.

scenes.vo: Read what it asks. Mention means list, briefly. Impact means say what each eruption did. So there are two jobs. Where did they happen? And what did they do to each region?

lines.text: NOAA's database lists seven significant eruptions for twenty twenty-one.
Three in the Americas, two in Europe, one in Africa, one in Asia.
That is NOAA's filter, not a count of every eruption.

scenes.vo: Start with the where. NOAA's database lists seven significant eruptions for twenty twenty-one. Three in the Americas, two in Europe, one in Africa, one in Asia. That is NOAA's filter, not a count of every eruption.

lines.text: Hunga Tonga is not on that list.
It erupted in January twenty twenty-two.
Tonga is the famous one, so it sneaks into answers.

scenes.vo: But now the trap. Hunga Tonga is not on that list. It erupted in January twenty twenty-two. Tonga is the famous one, so it sneaks into answers. Leave it out.

lines.text: So how big was twenty twenty-one?
None passed four on the explosivity scale.
La Palma put out one point eight million tonnes of sulphur dioxide.
That is about a tenth of Pinatubo.

scenes.vo: So how big was twenty twenty-one? None passed four on the explosivity scale. La Palma put out one point eight million tonnes of sulphur dioxide. That is about a tenth of Pinatubo. So the damage stayed regional.

lines.text: Regional is the word to build on.
Each eruption hit a place in its own way.
Ash and water in the Caribbean.
Houses and power in Central Africa.

scenes.vo: Regional is the word to build on. Each eruption hit a place in its own way. Ash and water in the Caribbean. Houses and power in Central Africa. Air in Europe. Reefs in the Pacific.

blocks.text: NOAA's database lists _seven significant eruptions_ in 2021, none above VEI 4: regional in effect, not global.
1. Where they occurred
• Americas 3 (Ecuador, Guatemala, _St Vincent_), Europe 2 (Italy, _La Palma_), Africa 1 (Nyiragongo), Asia 1 (Semeru). • Only St Vincent and Semeru reached VEI 4. • Hunga Tonga is 2022, not 2021.
2. Impact on regional environment

• _Caribbean_: St Vincent's ash covered the island; about 16,000 were evacuated, water and power failed, banana farming was hit. • _Central Africa_: Nyiragongo destroyed about 5,000 houses and disrupted water and power. • _Europe_: La Palma erupted for 85 days, covering 12 km2 in lava; 1.8 Mt SO2 drifted over Africa, Europe and the Caribbean. • _Pacific_: Fukutoku-Oka-no-Ba's pumice raft drifted 1,300 km, stranding on Okinawa's reefs and mangroves.
So the harm was regional: ash, water, land, air. La Palma's SO2 was a tenth of Pinatubo's; no global cooling followed.

scenes.vo: Now we write. One hundred and fifty words, about seven minutes. Open with NOAA's seven, and say the effect was regional, not global.

scenes.vo: Section two is the impact, one region at a time, each with a figure. St Vincent: sixteen thousand evacuated, water and power lost. Nyiragongo: five thousand houses. La Palma: eighty-five days and twelve square kilometres of lava. Its plume reached Africa and the Caribbean. And a pumice raft drifted thirteen hundred kilometres to Okinawa's reefs.

weak.text: Hunga Tonga erupted in 2021 and cooled the Earth.
weak.miss: Tonga was January 2022; no source gives any global cooling for 2021

weak.text: Gives a total count of all eruptions in the year.
weak.miss: no allowed source gives one; NOAA's seven are only the significant ones
the question's second job is impact: water, farms, air and sea

weak.text: La Palma's gas stayed over the Canary Islands.
weak.miss: the plume reached Africa, Europe and the Caribbean

scenes.vo: Now the easy answer beside it. It adds Tonga and a global cooling. It gives a total count nobody can source. It lists eruptions but not their impact. It says the plume stayed on the island. Both took seven minutes. Only one did both jobs.
